title: Upstream Source & Custom Patch Preservation Audit (+ PHASE-00 Local Runtime State)

audit_metadata.summary: All 7 core components and 5 supporting trees were audited byte-for-byte via SHA-256 and read-only Git inspection. CRITICAL FINDING: <LEGACY_MONOREPO_ROOT> was snapshotted on 2026-11-20T22:02:43+07:00 (commit d649451) with cross-platform path refactors (paths.js, paths.py), while 100% of live Windows services continued running from <LEGACY_PLATFORM_ROOT> and <LOCAL_RUNTIME_DATA>/hermes where three major feature waves were subsequently built on Nov 21-23 without full backporting into <LEGACY_MONOREPO_ROOT>: (1) 23-phase Telegram Control Center (8 new modules in office-bridge/telegram-control + 151.8 KB telegram-control-adapter.js + updated unified-company-control plugin), (2) 11-Agent GitHub Skill Registry & Security Gate (integration/agent_skills_manager.py, office-bridge/adapters/agent-skills-bridge.js, skill-registry/manifests+checksums, org_provisioner.py), and (3) Nov 23 Paperclip Hermes adapter patches (execute.ts/js --query-file + skills.ts/js skill-registry junction/symlink reconciliation) plus Hermes Agent upstream advancement to eb49b8920a with 1-line error_classifier.py patch. Reconciling both trees using a Pinned-Upstream + Declarative-Patch + First-Class Source architecture preserves 100% of custom features while shrinking repository size from 1,037.68 MiB (93,957 files) to ~11.5 MiB (<950 tracked files, 98.9% reduction).

hermes-agent.recommended_strategy: DO_NOT_VENDOR_FULL_TREE: Pin upstream commit SHA eb49b8920a25ffa7bb2fadf548fe819221ca79d7 in config/upstream-locks.json; fetch via shallow git archive/clone --depth 1 during Docker image build (excluding apps/desktop, website, tests, evals, nix -> saves >180 MiB) and apply patches/hermes-agent/0001-error-classifier-integrator.patch.

custom_patches.description: Writes prompt to temporary file and passes --query-file when process.platform === 'win32' || prompt.length > 6000 (preventing Windows 32KB CreateProcessW ENAMETOOLONG and keeping large multi-agent prompts clean on Linux), unlinking tempQueryFile in finally{}.

Reconciles Paperclip & Skill-Registry managed skills (-- namespaced runtimeName and skill-registry paths) cleanly across directory symlinks/junctions, with EPERM/ENOSYS copy fallback via materializePaperclipSkillCopy.

paperclip.recommended_strategy: INSTALL_PINNED_NPM_PACKAGE_PLUS_DECLARATIVE_PATCH: Do not vendor 17,360-file (245.78 MiB) Turborepo source or run multi-GB pnpm builds on a 2-vCPU/8-GB VPS. Match live production by locking paperclipai@2026.1117.0 in runtime/paperclip-app/package.json (with external PostgreSQL 16 container on Linux instead of @embedded-postgres/windows-x64) and applying patches/paperclip/hermes-paperclip-adapter+2026.1117.0.patch (plus keeping source .ts patch in patches/paperclip/source-reference.patch).

vulnclaw.recommended_strategy: PINNED_UPSTREAM_FETCH_ZERO_PATCHES: 0 files modified vs upstream v0.4.1 (0b34878f84b089b21fcf85ecd445315f14df0672).
